title: Aprende a bailar con 4 pasos básicos el PASACALLE

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher methodically breaks down basic folk dance steps by counting aloud and explaining directional movement step-by-step. She demonstrates exercises both stationary and with music while reminding participants of correct posture and hand placement.

lesson_structure.note: Welcome and overview of the pasacalle basic steps
Breakdown of the first basic step with march and hip movement
Practicing the first step with music
Breakdown of the second step called paseíllo
Practicing the first and second steps with music
Breakdown of the third step called trenzado
Practicing all three steps combined with music

metaphors: Hacer un círculo en tu mismo puesto

steps_taught.name: Paso básico
steps_taught.description: Marching in place with hip movement moving right and left.

steps_taught.name: Paseíllo
steps_taught.description: Moving in a small circle to the right and left using basic steps.

steps_taught.name: Trenzado
steps_taught.description: Crossing legs alternately behind and to the side.

what_works: Clear verbal counting and repetition without stopping
what_hinders: No back or side angle demonstration for intricate footwork

quotes.text: en este video vamos a aprender los pasos básicos del pasacalle
el tercer paso básico que se llama el paseíllo
un pasito que se llama trenzado

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher marches in place counting from 1 to 8 facing forward
Teacher instructs hand placement on waist for women and behind for men

extraction.distinctive_method: Explicitly instructing different hand placements for men and women during practice.
